_doc: River-port whitelist. A city listed here is flagged isCoastal=true even when it sits >10 km from open ocean, because the city is on a navigable river/estuary that connects to the sea. Keys match GeoNames asciiName (column 3 of cities500.txt). Reviewed cities only — fabricated entries forbidden. Caspian-shore river ports (e.g., Astrakhan on the Volga) deliberately excluded since the Caspian is not ocean-connected.
